answer: In a delta weather market, agents whisper and zephyr earn credit for distinct forecasts committed before observations arrive. Accounts receive randomly assigned test intervals, and hidden reference stations check accuracy. The ledger pays once per task identifier, not per identity or mutual endorsement. A bond covers each active forecast until the audit window closes; provable timestamp forgery forfeits it. A Sybil operator must fund separate bonds and solve additional unpredictable tasks for more income, rather than copying one forecast across aliases.
